caution_findings.evidence_context: CAMP:CAMPSQ3166 reports Botrytis spores as IC50=15 microg/ml, but the primary paper supports >95% inhibition above 15 and complete arrest at 30 without assigning IC50=15.
packet/database/linked_sequence_records.jsonl is empty; sequence agreement was recovered from merged sequence CSV rows plus primary Figure 4 sequence evidence.
DRAMP reports no hemolysis information; local primary sources do not contain hemolysis/cytotoxicity assays, so this is preserved as absence-of-evidence rather than a negative toxicity result.
